description.en: Ecosystem of open-source UI components built with Tailwind CSS utility classes.
description.zh: 生态成熟完备的开源 Tailwind CSS 组件库，深度支持 React、Vue 与 Svelte。

content.en: Flowbite is one of the most mature, battle-tested open-source component libraries built entirely on Tailwind CSS. With native wrappers for React, Vue, Svelte, and Angular, Flowbite offers everything from modals, datepickers, and navbars to comprehensive dashboard layouts.
content.zh: Flowbite 是 Tailwind CSS 生态中体系最为完备老牌的开源组件库之一。它原生提供 React、Vue、Svelte 与 Angular 等多框架绑定封装，涵盖表单控件、日期拾取器、导航栏、图表整合与复杂中后台交互，已服务数十万生产项目。
